bcc-memleak.reason: bcc memleak is not driven by DLA in this version; `dla attach bpftrace` counts mapped bytes per call stack (tier 3, root)

codeql.reason: codeql is not on PATH or in the tools directory

errorprone.reason: Error Prone jars not found in the tools directory (or DLA_ERRORPRONE_HOME)

gpu-nvml.reason: GPU memory (NVML, nvidia-smi) is not read by DLA in this version: device memory growth is a blind spot

sonar.reason: sonar-scanner is not installed and Sonar rules need a SonarQube or SonarCloud server
sonar.install_hint: install sonar-scanner, run a SonarQube or SonarCloud server and set SONAR_HOST_URL and SONAR_TOKEN (dla install sonar prints the steps)

spotbugs.reason: no class files: run dla probe --build

valgrind.reason: Valgrind is not run on the JVM: the virtual machine's own allocations drown the project's; use the allocator shim, jcmd NMT or `dla attach bpftrace`
